summary: The direct V key is bound to versionshort/doversion in both C and the JavaScript command table, but JS rejects versionshort at the repeated-command boundary before command dispatch. It also has no doversion handler. C version.c:doversion prints getversionstring() and returns ECMD_OK when menu_requested is false, which is the branch this recording reaches. JS already has the matching getversionstring() and doextversion(); the missing behavior is the short command path and its admission.

source.branch: doversion when iflags.menu_requested is false; print getversionstring() with pline and return ECMD_OK. The alternate true branch delegates to doextversion.
callers: cmd.c:commands_init binds V to the versionshort row and doversion; cmd.c:rhack dispatches that bound command

evidence: The accepted v48 evaluation reports 1/2 screens and cursors matched, all 2897 RNG calls matched, and a first stop at segment 0 step 1 because JS rejects the hero command at the repeated-command boundary. The saved queue preserves the exact manifest, recording and evaluation hashes above.

The v48 manifest identifies the C entry point as version.c:doversion via V / #versionshort. In upstream cmd.c:1926-1927, the V row is named versionshort and maps to doversion. In upstream version.c:156-165, doversion returns doextversion when menu_requested is set; otherwise it calls pline("%s", getversionstring(...)) and returns ECMD_OK.

The production JavaScript key table has the corresponding V/versionshort/doversion row in js/extcmdlist_data.js. However, js/cmd.js:1905-1916 omits versionshort from ADMITTED_COMMANDS, so rhack refuses it before dispatch. The doextcmd switch has a doextversion case but no doversion case. js/version.js exports getversionstring() and doextversion(), but no doversion(). The recorder short-version string itself is already represented by getversionstring().

The recording has exactly one gameplay input, V, after its initial screen; C produces the short version message without an RNG call or turn. The implementation scope is version.c:doversion plus its existing V command dispatch/admission path; the version-string helper and extended-version branch already exist.
